scope: LSP semantic rename to current-snapshot existing-file edits with individual approvals, preflight, backups and edit checks; no server-driven edit or command channel.

source_seal.selection: Same complete Python/project/config/CI input selection as line-patches-20261029.json; docs/reports and virtual environments excluded.

real_engine.scope: real clangd on two disposable C++ files; no project-wide index or agent coding-score claim
real_engine.limit: clangd returned unversioned targets. The application binds bytes after the response; this does not prove server-index snapshot consistency or complete project coverage.

contracts.authorization: RPC/initialize/synchronization approval plus each actual full file diff; RPC result grants no write authority; disabled edit_file removes rename schema and blocks backend
contracts.proposal: changes or preferred documentChanges; prepareRename when advertised; UTF-16 ranges against complete current UTF-8; plain existing-file TextEdits only
contracts.versions: integer document version must match synchronized decoded path identity and content hash; unversioned target bytes captured after response and reported
contracts.paths: whole-proposal refusal for private/outside/reparse targets, aliases, invalid ranges, unsupported annotations/resource operations or credentials; no filtering then partial application
contracts.lifecycle: close selected server before file reviews; owner/config/cancel guard includes single-file approvals; human review outside completed RPC deadline
contracts.failure: stop subsequent writes; retain confirmed prefix and batch ID, pending backup and uncertainty; never replay RPC, approval or cancelled write
contracts.text: strict UTF-16 boundaries and overlap checks; same-position insertion order, BOM and untouched CR/LF bytes preserved; newText is literal
contracts.history: common private per-file backups and batch labels; undo/redo and batch recovery keep existing retention/conflict/pending limits
contracts.integration: successful model rename enters post-edit fixed checks and independent final acceptance; local CLI/TUI makes zero model calls and leaves acceptance unverified
contracts.output: bounded counters and batch ID; optional redacted error detail measured after JSON escaping; never drop completed-prefix facts for diagnostics

sprig-lsp-rename-initial-20261029.finding: Initial local rename preflight forced model-action context with no served model guidance; preserve caller mode. New fixture also used platform-translated write_text while expecting LF bytes; use explicit bytes.

sprig-lsp-rename-output-budget-counterex.finding: After one completed file, quoted diagnostic text serialized to 1153 bytes against the original 1024-byte output cap. Count encoded JSON and omit optional detail before discarding prefix facts.

source_reading.protocol: Microsoft LSP 3.17 rename, WorkspaceEdit, TextDocumentEdit and Position source definitions
